title: The Lord Speaks to Lehi Again

Nephi asks why they have forgotten the Lord's deliverance from Laban and their obtaining the record.
Nephi says the Lord is able to do all things according to his will if people exercise faith in him, and urges faithfulness.

title: A Warning Against Returning to Jerusalem
summary: The speaker promises the land of promise on condition of faithfulness, foretells Jerusalem’s destruction, reports the rejection of prophets and persecution of his father, and warns those addressed against returning to Jerusalem.

The speaker reports that people sought his father’s life and drove him out of the land.
